title: Coherence of finite exceptional quotient mates
statement: Under the same finite-field, coefficient and geometric hypotheses as [def-sf-finite-exceptional-constructions], let b denote the specified mate of the inverse compact-support comparison q. For m≥n≥t, Q_X(n,t)(b(m,n,L)), followed by b(n,t,Q_Y(m,n)L) and G_t of the Y scalar associator, equals the X scalar associator at G_m L followed by b(m,t,L). For n=m, b(n,n,L) followed by G_n of the Y scalar multiplication unit equals the X scalar multiplication unit at G_n L. The associators are reassoc and the units are selfReduction of [def-sf-finite-exceptional-constructions]; all indices denote positive coefficient exponents.

source.place: Paragraph 2: coherent duality comparisons and identification of their adjunction maps

proof.text: Specialize comparison_composition to the three actual finite quotient changes and quotient_comp. Conjugate by finiteImageIso at each level: naturality moves the middle endpoint isomorphisms across scalar extension and they cancel. Fully faithful restriction gives the q cocycle with precisely reassoc at both endpoints. Specialize comparison_identity and quotient_id for the q identity with precisely selfReduction.

Take inverses of the q cocycle, then transpose under the three normalized adjunctions. The inverse Hom bijection sends v to F(v) followed by the counit. Naturality of q moves the first transposed component across the second q inverse; the triangle identities cancel the intermediate adjunction. Mate pasting yields exactly the b cocycle. The same computation on the identity q equation gives the b multiplication-unit equation. Neither step requires b invertible.

lean.statement:
theorem exceptional_quotient_coherence :
    (∀ {m n t : ℕ} (h : n ≤ m) (k : t ≤ n)
      (L : (domain l E Y m).FullSubcategory),
      (Q l E X k).map ((b l E D hl f c h).app L) ≫
          (b l E D hl f c k).app ((Q l E Y h).obj L) ≫
          (G l E D hl f c t).map ((reassoc l E Y h k).hom.app L) =
        (reassoc l E X h k).hom.app ((G l E D hl f c m).obj L) ≫
          (b l E D hl f c (k.trans h)).app L) ∧
    (∀ (n : ℕ) (L : (domain l E Y n).FullSubcategory),
      (b l E D hl f c (le_refl n)).app L ≫
          (G l E D hl f c n).map ((selfReduction l E Y n).hom.app L) =
        (selfReduction l E X n).hom.app ((G l E D hl f c n).obj L))
